exposure: First-trimester PAPP-A multiple of the median (MoM) levels >0.5
first-trimester PAPP-A multiple of the median (MoM) levels
First-trimester PAPP-A multiple of the median (MoM) levels ≤0.5
outcome: Rate of C/S due to fetal distress
cohort: 283 uncomplicated pregnancies that resulted in full-term live births via spontaneous labor or induction with oxytocin
finding: Low first-trimester PAPP-A levels (≤0.5 MoM) are associated with an increased risk of intrapartum fetal distress and C/S for fetal distress, regardless of labor induction.
mod_finding: The risk of intrapartum fetal distress and cesarean section due to fetal distress associated with low first-trimester PAPP-A levels was not affected by labor induction.
